name: liquor-express
description: Sistema de administración Liquor Express — monorepo (web Next.js + api Express) en un solo despliegue. JCA Soft · Kaizen

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/api install
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix apps/web run start" "npm --prefix apps/api run start"
